summary: Iteration 7: Validated the new DELETE /api/auth/account endpoint end-to-end (backend + frontend) plus regression on existing routes and the chef test account. All 4 backend pytest cases pass; the full frontend delete flow works (login → /settings → delete-account → delete-confirm → cancel → confirm → redirect to /login) and chef@cucina.ai regression still renders Oggi. No blocking issues found. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this change; SafeAreaView usage on /settings is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_account correctly pulls the user from their household and deletes the household when empty (lines 346-360). SHARED_COLLECTIONS is extended in-place with consumption_log/chat_messages/uploads/file_tokens/user_sessions so all personal docs are wiped.
auth.tsx.deleteAccount() sets user=null after DELETE; _layout.tsx effect then redirects to /(auth)/login automatically — verified live.

settings.tsx: web platform path shows inline confirm box with the three required testIDs (delete-account / delete-confirm / delete-cancel / delete-confirm-btn); native path uses Alert.alert — both branches match spec.
seed_data_creation: Test creates disposable users TEST_del_*, TEST_reg_*, TEST_bar_*, TEST_full_*, TEST_hhA/B/C_* via signup and self-cleans by calling DELETE /api/auth/account at the end of each test. chef@cucina.ai was NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_delete_account.py (pytest, uses EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Recipes list endpoint returns {items:[]} (not a bare list) and pantry returns {items:[]} as well — remember when writing shape assertions. MealCreate requires 'title' field even if recipe_id is provided. Login screen testIDs are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn (NOT login-*).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Verified: (1) DELETE returns {ok:true}, old bearer becomes 401, same email can re-signup with empty scoped collections. (2) Household: B leaves via delete → A still sees membership of 1; A deletes → household document removed and old invite_code returns 404 on join. (3) httpx-based /api/products/barcode/3017624010701 responds 200 with expected schema. (4) Frontend web confirm box appears/hides as spec'd and post-delete redirect lands on /login.
